speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Write it, and do not count. The pile under the clean sheet can stay a pile.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Workmen first. Then the brake. Then she wakes. If I begin with her I will punish her to have an ending, and I have not got one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The tables, and then the sheet. Four lines are enough to aim a morning.
